entities.name: Floris of Montmorency
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Floris van Montmorency, Baron of Montigny, was a Dutch nobleman and diplomat from the Spanish Netherlands.

As a prominent figure in the Habsburg administration, Floris played a key role in the complex web of alliances and rivalries between the Spanish Empire and the Protestant territories of Northern Europe.

His diplomatic efforts aimed to maintain the fragile peace between the Habsburgs and the Dutch rebels, while also navigating the treacherous waters of European politics.

Floris's legacy is marked by his role in shaping the early modern European diplomatic landscape, and his contributions to the development of modern Netherlands' international relations.

"The safety of our realm depends on the vigilance of our ambassadors," Floris once said, "and I have dedicated my life to ensuring that the Habsburgs remain vigilant in their pursuit of peace and prosperity."
